title: Fix `BeforeValidator` reference pointing at `AfterValidator`
body:
#### Description

`docs/contributing.md:199` renders `BeforeValidator` but cross-references `pydantic.functional_validators.AfterValidator` — on the built docs the label links to the AfterValidator API page, and on GitHub the unmatched reference renders as literal text. Made the label match the target (introduced by #12411).

#### Your checklist for this pull request

- [x] The pull request title is a good summary of the changes
- [x] Trivial change (docs tweak), no issue needed
